articles.summary: The Board of Directors of IBC Bank-Corpus Christi voted unanimously to appoint Thomas A. “Dos” Gates, Jr. to their board.
articles.title: IBC Bank - Corpus Christi Announces Addition of Thomas A. "Dos" Gates Jr. to Board of Directors

articles.summary: IBC’s Board of Directors approved the declaration of a .63 cents per share cash dividend for shareholders of record of Common Stock, $1.00 par value, as of the close of business on August 11, 2023, payable on August 25, 2023.
articles.title: International Bancshares Corporation Announces Cash Dividend Increase in Q2 of 2023
